name: T1 Entertainment & Sports
overview_text: T1 Entertainment & Sports is a global esports joint venture formed in October 2019 by South Korean telecommunications company SK Telecom and American sports and entertainment company Comcast Spectacor. It operates highly successful professional esports teams across various competitive gaming titles, most notably its League of Legends (LoL) Champions Korea (LCK) team. The organization focuses on competitive gaming culture, content, and merchandise, and has recently achieved significant financial growth and profitability.
